description: sqlite_parity and memory cases the current RedlineDB target fails against the pinned sqlite3 3.53.1 reference (scripts/sqlite/build-reference.sh). Listed failures are published as failures, never as passes or skips. `redline-testing run --sqlite-known-failures` and evidence_processor both require a suite's failed cases to be exactly its entries: an unlisted failure fails the run, and so does a listed case that passes, which leaves this file in the commit whose raw result shows it passing. stage is the verdict_reason every failing sample of the case records: target_semantic_failure when RedlineDB breaks the case's declared exit code or fragments, differential_mismatch when it keeps them but prints different bytes. Entries were seeded from the official lane run of 2026-09-27; reason quotes what RedlineDB printed then.

failures.name: EXPLAIN_BYTECODE
failures.reason: EXPLAIN prints RedlineDB's operator tree; the case declares the SQLite VDBE opcodes Init and ResultRow, and RedlineDB has no VDBE.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: EXPLAIN bytecode emulation or a reviewed exception

failures.name: DOT_SCHEMA_TABLES_INDEXES
failures.reason: `.schema` omits the `CREATE INDEX idx_t_a ON t(a);` statement that sqlite3 prints after the table.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_DUMP
failures.reason: `.dump` omits the leading `PRAGMA foreign_keys=OFF;` line that sqlite3 prints before `BEGIN TRANSACTION;`.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_FULLSCHEMA
failures.reason: `.fullschema` prints the sqlite_master rows where sqlite3 prints `/* No STAT tables available */`.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_PARAMETER
failures.reason: `.parameter list` separates the name and value with a tab (`@x\t7`); sqlite3 prints a space (`@x 7`).
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_DBCONFIG
failures.reason: `.dbconfig` prints `defensive on` once and unpadded; sqlite3 right-aligns the name and prints it after both the set and the query.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_CONNECTION
failures.reason: `.connection` prints no `ACTIVE 0: :memory:` listing.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_AUTH
failures.reason: `.auth on` prints no authorizer callback line (`authorizer: SELECT NULL NULL NULL NULL`).
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_CRLF
failures.reason:
RedlineDB reports `crlf is OFF` after `.crlf on`, as the pinned sqlite3 does on Linux, but then ends the first row with CRLF (`1
2
`); sqlite3 prints `1
2
`.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_EXPERT_OPTIONAL
failures.reason: `.expert` prints its recommendation twice, without sqlite3's blank separator lines and without the `(a=?)` constraint on the SEARCH line.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_SHA3SUM
failures.reason: `.sha3sum` prints 64 zeros; sqlite3 prints the 56-digit SHA3-224 hash of the database content.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_CLONE_TEMPFILE
failures.reason: `.clone` prints no per-table progress line (`t... done`).
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_SHELL_SIDE_EFFECT
failures.reason: `.shell printf shell-ok` output gains a newline (`shell-ok\ndone`); sqlite3 passes the command's bytes through unchanged (`shell-okdone`).
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_SYSTEM_SIDE_EFFECT
failures.reason: `.system printf system-ok` output gains a newline (`system-ok\ndone`); sqlite3 passes the command's bytes through unchanged (`system-okdone`).
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: OPT_INTERACTIVE_CATALOG
failures.reason: With `-interactive` and empty stdin, sqlite3 prints the prompt `sqlite> ` and a newline at end of input; RedlineDB prints `sqlite>` with neither the trailing space nor the newline.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: OPT_ESCAPE_SYMBOL
failures.reason: `-escape symbol` prints char(1) as the raw 0x01 byte where sqlite3 3.53.1 prints U+2401, so stdout lacks the declared `␁x`; RedlineDB does not map control characters to their U+2400 symbols.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: DOT_SHOW_LISTS_SETTINGS
failures.reason: `.show` pads names to a different width, prints `separator` where sqlite3 prints `colseparator` and `rowseparator`, omits `stats`, and prints `width: (none)` for an empty width list.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: OPT_READONLY_REFUSES_WRITE
failures.reason: RedlineDB refuses the case's fixture file (`database path exists as a regular file`), so it never reaches the write that must fail with `readonly` under `-readonly`.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI open of an existing file under -readonly

failures.name: OPT_MEMTRACE
failures.reason: `-memtrace` is accepted but prints nothing; the case declares the MEMTRACE allocator trace on stderr.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: OPT_PCACHETRACE
failures.reason: `-pcachetrace` is accepted but prints nothing; the case declares the PCACHETRACE page-cache trace on stderr.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RedlineDB CLI dot-command and option output

failures.name: ADD_COLUMN_WITH_CHECK_ENFORCED
failures.reason: A column added by `ALTER TABLE ... ADD COLUMN b INTEGER CHECK (b >= 0)` is not visible to the next INSERT, which fails with `no such column: b` instead of the declared `CHECK constraint failed`.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: ADD COLUMN with CHECK (case 10413)

failures.name: RAISE_OUTSIDE_TRIGGER
failures.reason: `SELECT RAISE(ABORT, 'no')` outside a trigger raises the abort (`constraint violation: no`) instead of rejecting RAISE with `RAISE() may only be used within a trigger-program`.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: RAISE outside a trigger (case 10570)

failures.name: AFFINITY_INTEGER_BLOB_HEX
failures.reason: The blob x'01ab' is printed as ^A then the raw byte 0xAB by sqlite3; RedlineDB prints U+FFFD (EF BF BD) in place of the byte that is not UTF-8. Lossy capture used to hide this.
failures.owner: Phase 4l: BLOB bytes in CLI output
